These Viral Chicken Tortilla Kebabs are crispy outside and juicy inside. Just layer, cut and bake — easy and delicious! Perfect for dinner, snacks or parties. You have to try this! Ingredients: 550 g chicken mince 1 onion (finely chopped & squeezed) 1 red bell pepper (finely chopped & squeezed) Parsley 2 garlic cloves 1 tbsp sour cream Salt & black pepper Mozzarella Flour tortillas Butter sauce: 30 g butter 1 tbsp oil 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp tomato paste 1 garlic clove Chili flakes Salt Parsley A little water Garlic dip: 100 g yogurt 1 tbsp mayonnaise 1 garlic clove Salt Pepper Parsley Instructions: Mix chicken with onion, bell pepper, parsley, garlic, sour cream and spices. Spread about 125 g filling on each tortilla. Add mozzarella and stack. Insert skewers and cut into strips. Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes. Brush with butter sauce and bake another 15 minutes. Serve with garlic dip. #chickenrecipe #viralrecipe #easyrecipe #tortilla #dinnerideas

these viral sheet pan pizza tater tots are about to be your go-to game day little snackie 🏈🍕 Ingredients: 1 bag frozen tater tots 14oz jar pizza sauce shredded mozzarella cheese mini pepperoni slices grated parmesan cheese red pepper flakes Instructions: On a foil-lined baking sheet, bake frozen tater tots at 425° for 20-24 minutes, flipping halfway through. On another foil-lined baking sheet, pour pizza sauce evenly, followed by an even layer of shredded mozzarella cheese, and mini pepperoni slices (add any of your favorite pizza toppings too!). Bake at 425° for 8-10 minutes, and broil on high for 2-3 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly. Slide and pour pizza pan over baked tater tots, then top with a little grated parmesan and red pepper flakes. Enjoy! 😋 #pizza #snack #recipe #creatorsearchinsights #sheetpanpizza

these viral nutella cheesecake stuffed cookies are sooo satisfying 🍫🍰🍪 Ingredients: 1 tub @Philly Cream Cheese no-bake cheesecake filling  1 jar @nutellausa hazelnut spread 4 slices @Pillsbury chocolate chip cookie dough Instructions: Mix nutella spread and cheesecake filling and place 4 dollops on a parchment lined baking sheet. Freeze for 30-60 minutes or until firm. Press slices of cookie dough flat and place 1 frozen nutella cheesecake dollop in the center of each slice. Form the dough around the nutella cheesecake to cover each dollop completely and bake cookies on a parchment lined baking sheet at 350° for 16-17 minutes. Allow to cool for 5 minutes and enjoy! 😋 #cheesecake #baking #dessert #recipe #creatorsearchinsights

these biscoff pretzels are the crunchy little treat you didn’t know you needed 🍯🥨 Ingredients: 1 bag pretzels ½ cup @Biscoff creamy cookie butter spread ½ cup white chocolate chips 1½ cups biscoff cookies (crushed) ½ cup powdered sugar Instructions: Melt biscoff cookie butter with white chocolate chips in a large microwave-safe mixing bowl for 30-second increments until smooth. Pour pretzels over mixture and toss to coat evenly. In a separate bowl, combine crushed biscoff cookies and powdered sugar. Add crushed cookie mixture to the coated pretzels and toss until fully covered. Allow to cool slightly and enjoy! 😋 #biscoff#biscofft #recipe #tiktokfood #creatorsearchinsights
